title: NATIVE ON build, tier 2 (Agent 7): command slots e0 and frames in flight e1 vs n0; VSync v0 vs latency wait g1. Title/attract loop, no input needed
notes: Spec: perf-notes/agent7-present.md, 'Runner specs for Agent 8', tier 2. Run tier 1 (matrix-native-tier1.json) first. BIN DIR: build/agent2/native-bin (staged 21:48).
Frame times: native-frames.csv; frames=native makes the runner set LEGO_NATIVE_FRAME_METRICS=<run>\native-frames.csv in every arm. Agent 7 asks for at least 3 rounds (5 preferred: -Repeats 5).
Groups: 'ring' compares e0 and e1 with n0 (Agent 7 reads e1 against e0: compare those two rows); 'vsync' compares g1 with v0.

e0-diag and e1-diag (group 'diag', 1 run each) add LEGO_NATIVE_TIMING=1 so frame_slot_wait_ms, acquire_cpu_ms and present_submit_cpu_ms are filled. That turns on texture timing, which perturbs frame times: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, never timing.

game.log checks: e1 'frames-in-flight cap=2', then '... waited on N of the last 600 presents' every 600 presents; v0 swap-chain line 'vsync on'; g1 'swap-chain latency wait=1' and 'swap-chain max frame latency=... latency_wait=1 set=...'.
After the matrix: python bench\agent7\native_frames_summary.py <run dirs> for Agent 7.

arms.note: Agent 7 n0: native defaults, VSync off, cap 240 (reference for e0 and e1)
Agent 7 e0: the bigger command ring alone (e0 vs n0)
Agent 7 e1: e0 + frames-in-flight cap 2 (e1 vs e0: fps, p99, sd). Check 'frames-in-flight cap=2'
Agent 7 v0: VSync on (reference for g1). Check the swap-chain line shows 'vsync on'
Agent 7 g1: VSync on + swap-chain latency wait (g1 vs v0: sd, p99). Check 'swap-chain latency wait=1'
